description: Source code implementing retry wait calculations based on TR-069 standards, including random seed generation, retry delay computation, and handling of unknown base times.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_Init
methods.description: Initializes random number generator seeds for threads.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_Calculate
methods.description: Calculates delay time until next retry based on retry count, minimum interval, and multiplier.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_UseRandomBaseIfUnknownTime
methods.description: Returns a random base time if input is UNKNOWN_TIME, otherwise returns the input base.

methods.name: GenerateSeed
methods.description: Generates a seed for random number generation using /dev/urandom or MAC address and current time.
